cases.task: Run the next GGUF model on k7000 after selecting it from the remote inventory.
assertions: Requires model-specific Surf research before inference
Requires sanitized KB/QMD notes and a bounded plan preview
Runs one model separately rather than launching an unreviewed batch
Preserves Vulkan0, Vulkan1, and applicable dual-GPU configurations

cases.task: The model run returns SSH_TIMEOUT during a context probe. What should happen next?
assertions: Stops blind retries and parameter sweeps
Searches local KB/QMD before external investigation
Uses Surf CLI and authoritative runtime/model sources
Keeps the result inconclusive unless one justified bounded rerun establishes more

cases.task: A GGUF run fails with an unfamiliar backend error after pre-run research.
assertions: Does not collapse it into generic blocked or OOM
Investigates the exact stable error through KB and Surf
Captures a reusable lesson when the fix is non-obvious
